description: Contract for the SINGLE sanctioned validation-agent installer. It supports two EXPLICIT deployment profiles (no inference) and is the only mechanism that may install/reconfigure the GuvFXBetaAgent service. WinSW / sc config / secedit must never be called by hand. Validated by tests_supervised_installer.py.
common_gates: interpreter identity by PE metadata before execution
interpreter runtime import check (agent bundle imports) under -Apply
scoped NTFS ACLs (Modify on state/tombstones/slots; ReadAndExecute on code/golden/winsw/venv)
post-install identity assignment: sc config obj= NT SERVICE\GuvFXBetaAgent (verify ChangeServiceConfig SUCCESS)
SeServiceLogonRight granted to the service SID (LSA), preserving all other rights
VERIFY: state Stopped, ProcessId 0 (install-only; no start, both profiles)
VERIFY: no pywin32 DLL created/modified in System32 or the base interpreter (measured before/after)
VERIFY: DACL ACE present for the service SID on every granted dir
automatic rollback to the pre-install snapshot on ANY verification failure

Dark.note: exactly the historical install-only behaviour; nothing changes

Supervised.token_substitution: __SET_AT_INSTALL__ replaced with a NON-SECRET per-install marker at stage; value never logged; staged XML must be ASCII and placeholder-free
Supervised.note: min-hardening PR #292 target; STILL installs STOPPED (first start is a separate gated action; Automatic means start on next boot)

identity_guarantee: WinSW v2.12 installs LocalSystem regardless of <serviceaccount>; the installer ALWAYS assigns the virtual account post-install and FAILS CLOSED + ROLLS BACK unless SERVICE_START_NAME == NT SERVICE\GuvFXBetaAgent before returning success.

rollback.no_prior_service: cleanly uninstalls the service the run created
rollback.bundle_scope: the Python bundle backup/restore is the paired operator step (deploy package section 2); the installer owns the SERVICE, not the code bundle
rollback.incomplete_rollback: if StartName != NT SERVICE after restore, the installer raises a MANUAL-OPERATOR-INTERVENTION error (never silently leaves a wrong identity)
